plazas.notes: Bakwena: 'Murrayhill Ramps'. Booths: OSM nodes 914980805 (northbound off-ramp) and 914980808 (southbound on-ramp); midpoint.

plazas.name: Kranskop
plazas.notes: Mainline at Middelfontein between Bela-Bela and Modimolle. Poster: 'KRANSKOP Mainline'.

plazas.name: Kranskop ramp
plazas.notes: Poster: 'KRANSKOP Ramp'. Serves Bela-Bela–Modimolle traffic (Foresight: 'Warmbaths – Nylstroom'). No booth node in OSM; coordinates are the centre of the two tolled R33 (Modimolle/Marble Hall) ramps that run beside the mainline plaza: OSM ways 32389615 (northbound off-ramp) and 23256068 (southbound on-ramp). Accurate to roughly 200 m.

plazas.name: Nyl
plazas.notes: Mainline between Mookgophong and Mokopane. Poster: 'NYL Mainline'.

plazas.name: Nyl ramp
plazas.notes: Poster: 'NYL Ramp'. Serves Mookgophong–Mokopane traffic (Foresight: 'Naboomspruit – Potgietersrus'). No booth node in OSM; coordinates are the centre of the two tolled R101 (Mokopane/Marble Hall) ramps beside the mainline plaza: OSM ways 68480318 (northbound off-ramp) and 68480337 (southbound on-ramp). Accurate to roughly 200 m.

plazas.name: Sebetiela ramp
plazas.notes: Poster: 'SEBETIELA Ramp'. Booths at the R101 (Mokopane/Marble Hall) interchange south-east of Mokopane: OSM nodes 823723797 (northbound off-ramp) and 919873910 (southbound on-ramp); midpoint.

plazas.name: Capricorn
plazas.notes: Mainline north of Polokwane. Poster: 'CAPRICORN Mainline'.

plazas.notes: Mainline near Musina. Poster: 'BAOBAB Mainline'.

plazas.notes: Poster: 'TSITSIKAMMA Mainline/Ramp' (one tariff for both). Coordinates are the mainline booth; the ramp booths on the R102 (Nature's Valley / Bloukrans Pass) link are OSM nodes 3095966007 and 944650506, about 600 m north-west.

plazas.name: Izotsha ramp
plazas.notes: Poster: 'IZOTSHA Ramp'. Booths: OSM nodes 699693814 and 734039235; midpoint.

plazas.name: Oribi ramp (N)
plazas.notes: Poster: 'ORIBI Ramp(N)'. Booth on the northbound off-ramp signed Port Shepstone/Kokstad (OSM way 55751852).

plazas.name: Umtentweni ramp
plazas.notes: Poster: 'UMTENTWENI Ramp'. Booths: OSM nodes 734064745 (southbound off-ramp) and 734064747 (northbound on-ramp); midpoint.

plazas.name: King Shaka Airport ramp
plazas.notes: Poster: 'KING SHAKA AIR PORT Ramp'. Single booth on the airport link toward Durban (OSM way 44946190).

plazas.name: oThongathi
plazas.notes: Mainline (Tongaat). Poster: 'OTHONGATHI Mainline'.

plazas.name: oThongathi ramp (S & N)
plazas.notes: Poster: 'OTHONGATHI Ramp(S&N)' – one tariff row for both ramps. Booths at the M43 interchange north of the mainline: OSM nodes 578217606 (northbound on-ramp) and 578217611 (southbound off-ramp); midpoint.

plazas.name: Mvoti
plazas.notes: Mainline. Poster: 'MVOTI Mainline'.

plazas.name: Mandini ramp
plazas.notes: Poster: 'MANDINI Ramp'. Booths: OSM nodes 836592081 (southbound on-ramp) and 836581828 (northbound off-ramp to Mandini/Tugela Mouth); midpoint.

plazas.name: Dokodweni ramp
plazas.notes: Poster: 'DOKODWENI Ramp'. Booths at the R66 (Gingindlovu/Eshowe) interchange: OSM nodes 269459443 (southbound on-ramp) and 589014401 (northbound off-ramp); midpoint.

plazas.name: Mtunzini
plazas.notes: Mainline south of the Mtunzini interchange. Poster: 'MTUNZINI Mainline'.

plazas.name: Mtunzini ramp (S)
plazas.notes: Poster: 'MTUNZINI Ramp (S)'. Booth on the southbound off-ramp to Mtunzini (OSM way 70045913). Identity confirmed by the Tracks4Africa listing 'Mtunzini Toll Gate - South Off Ramp' at the same spot (its 2013 tariff R28 lines up with today's R53).

plazas.name: Mtunzini ramp (N)
plazas.notes: Poster: 'MTUNZINI Ramp (N)'. Booth on the northbound on-ramp toward Empangeni/Richards Bay (OSM way 70045915). Tracks4Africa 'Mtunzini Toll Gate - North On Ramp' (2013 tariff R6) at the same spot.

plazas.name: Mariannhill
plazas.notes: Mainline between Pinetown and Key Ridge; SANRAL-managed (not part of the N3TC concession). Poster: 'MARIANNHILL Mainline'.

plazas.name: Mooi River
plazas.notes: Mainline. Poster: 'MOOI Mainline'.

plazas.name: Mooi River ramp (S)
plazas.notes: Poster: 'MOOI Ramp (S)'. Booth on the southbound on-ramp signed Pietermaritzburg (OSM way 67491831, node named 'Mooi Ramp Plaza'), 400 m south of the mainline.

plazas.name: Mooi River ramp (N)
plazas.notes: Poster: 'MOOI Ramp (N)'. Booth on the northbound off-ramp signed Mooi River/Greytown (OSM way 23048072).

plazas.name: Treverton ramp
plazas.notes: Poster: 'TREVERTON Ramp'. Booths: OSM nodes 815583899 (southbound off-ramp to Mooi River) and 815650197 (northbound on-ramp toward Harrismith); midpoint.

plazas.name: Bergville ramp
plazas.notes: Poster: 'BERGVILLE Ramp'. Booths at the N11/R616 (Ladysmith/Bergville) interchange: OSM nodes 671785437 (northbound off-ramp) and 671785442 (southbound on-ramp); midpoint. Class 2 (R35) is unusually close to class 1 (R30) but is printed that way on the poster and in every cross-check source.

plazas.notes: Poster: 'TUGELA EAST Ramp (E)'. Single plaza on the R103 link on the east side of the Tugela mainline plaza (OSM node 671775188 on a two-way road), so direction is given as both.

plazas.name: Quagga

plazas.notes: Mainline. Poster: 'SWARTRUGGENS Mainline'.

plazas.name: Marikana
plazas.notes: Mainline. Poster: 'MARIKANA Mainline'.

plazas.name: Brits
plazas.notes: Mainline. Poster: 'BRITS Mainline'.

plazas.name: K99 ramp
plazas.notes: Poster: 'K99 Ramp'. Bakwena's page calls the same plaza 'Doornpoort Ramps' (identical tariff). Booths at the interchange about 1 km west of the Doornpoort mainline: OSM nodes 914847580 ('Doonpoort Ramp Tollgate') and 914847368 ('Dr. Swanepoel Ramp Tollgate'); midpoint.

plazas.name: Doornpoort
plazas.notes: Mainline, Pretoria North. Poster: 'DOORNPOORT Mainline'.

plazas.name: Donkerhoek ramp
plazas.notes: Poster: 'DONKERHOEK Ramp'. West of Diamond Hill (Foresight: 'W ramp'). Booths at the R964 interchange: OSM nodes 3381092758 (westbound on-ramp) and 3381092759 (eastbound off-ramp); midpoint. TRAC site: same tariff.

plazas.name: Cullinan ramp
plazas.notes: Poster: 'CULLINAN Ramp'. West of Diamond Hill (Foresight: 'W ramp'). Unnamed OSM booths at the R515 (Cullinan/Rayton) interchange: nodes 60954009 (eastbound off-ramp) and 746754012 (westbound on-ramp); midpoint. TRAC site: same tariff.

plazas.name: Diamond Hill
plazas.notes: Mainline. Poster: 'DIAMOND HILL Mainline'. TRAC site: same tariff.

plazas.name: Valtaki East ramp
plazas.notes: Poster: 'VALTAKI EAST Ramp' (TRAC: 'Valtaki Ramp'; Foresight: 'E ramp', i.e. east of Diamond Hill). Unnamed OSM booths at the Valtaki/Witfontein interchange 7 km east of Diamond Hill: nodes 5329407428 (eastbound on-ramp) and 5329407432 (westbound off-ramp); midpoint.

plazas.name: Ekandustria East ramp
plazas.notes: Poster: 'EKANDUSTRIA EAST Ramp' (TRAC: 'Ekandustria Ramp'). This row and the three below were dropped by the first text extraction of the poster PDF; a second parse and the copy of the same SANRAL material on bakwena.co.za confirm them. Unnamed OSM booths at the R568 (Ekandustria/Bronkhorstspruit West) interchange: nodes 5329438349 (eastbound on-ramp) and 5329438350 (westbound off-ramp); midpoint.

plazas.name: Middelburg
plazas.notes: Mainline (OSM spells it 'Middleburg Toll Plaza'). Poster: 'MIDDELBURG Mainline'. TRAC site: same tariff.

plazas.name: Machadodorp (Machado)
plazas.notes: Mainline near eNtokozweni (Machadodorp); TRAC calls it 'Machado Mainline'. Poster: 'MACHADODORP Mainline'. Highest class 4 tariff in the country.

plazas.name: Nkomazi
plazas.notes: Mainline between Malelane and Komatipoort. Poster: 'NKOMAZI Mainline'. TRAC site: same tariff. Mozambican plazas (Moamba, Maputo) are priced in meticais and are not on the SANRAL poster.

plazas.name: Gosforth
plazas.notes: Mainline (Gosforth Park, Germiston). Poster: 'GOSFORTH Mainline'.

plazas.name: Gosforth ramp (W)
plazas.notes: Poster: 'GOSFORTH Ramp(W)'. Booth on the westbound lane signed N3 (Durban/Pretoria) that runs beside the mainline plaza (OSM way 687811281). Two more westbound ramp booths sit at the M37 interchange 1.6 km west (OSM nodes 59748999 and 288950188).

plazas.name: Gosforth ramp (E)
plazas.notes: Poster: 'GOSFORTH Ramp(E)'. Booth on the eastbound on-ramp lane from the M37 interchange that runs beside the mainline plaza (OSM way 687811276). Class 2 (R29) is almost four times class 1 (R7.50) but is printed that way in every source.

plazas.name: Dalpark
plazas.notes: Mainline (Brakpan). Poster: 'DALPARK Mainline'.

plazas.name: Denne ramp
plazas.notes: Poster: 'DENNE Ramp'. Booths on the Brakpan ramps: OSM nodes 256772010/3408234095 (eastbound) and 303167368/3408234094 (westbound); midpoint.

plazas.name: Leandra
plazas.notes: Mainline. Poster: 'LEANDRA Mainline'.

plazas.name: Leandra ramp

plazas.name: Trichardt
plazas.notes: Mainline. Poster: 'TRICHARDT Mainline'.

plazas.name: Ermelo
